bio.text: Lindsay James, a Democrat from Dubuque, was in her fourth term in the Iowa House when she announced in August 2025 that she was running for Iowa's 2nd Congressional District; Little Village reported she was first elected in 2018 and became House Minority Whip in 2023.

According to Little Village, James is an ordained Presbyterian minister who grew up in Oregon, holds a bachelor's degree in communications from Santa Clara University and a master's in divinity from Fuller Theological Seminary, and co-founded the Loras College Peace Institute.

sources.title: James is the latest Democrat to enter the race to take on Ashley Hinson in 2026
